# BridgeCodec
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/chain-bridge/src/libraries/BridgeCodec.sol)

**Title:**
BridgeCodec

Library for encoding and decoding bridge operation payloads with OperationType prefixes

Centralizes the logic for adding/removing uint16 OperationType prefixes to payloads


## Functions
### encodePayload

Encodes a payload with an OperationType prefix


```solidity
function encodePayload(
    BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType,
    bytes memory data
)
    internal
    pure
    returns (bytes memory);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|The operation type to prefix the payload with|
|`data`|`bytes`|The data to encode|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bytes`|The encoded payload with OperationType prefix (uint16 + data)|


### decodePayload

Decodes a payload to extract OperationType and data


```solidity
function decodePayload(bytes calldata raw)
    internal
    pure
    returns (BridgeTypes.OperationType operationType, bytes memory data);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`raw`|`bytes`|The raw payload with OperationType prefix|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`operationType`|`BridgeTypes.OperationType`|The extracted operation type|
|`data`|`bytes`|The remaining payload data after removing the prefix|


## Errors
### InvalidPayloadLength
Error thrown when payload is too short to contain operation type


```solidity
error InvalidPayloadLength();
```

### InvalidOperationType
Error thrown when operation type is invalid


```solidity
error InvalidOperationType();
```
